windows.label: No altars
windows.description: Outgoing comparison with zero active altars. Other buttons hold one to four altars active: each removes 15% damage with Arclight/Emberlight, or 25% with other weapons, rounded per hitsplat after bolt effects. All states share one 450-HP comparison pool. Random altar activation, cooldowns, running, adds, incoming attacks and actual kill timing are excluded.

windows.label: 1 active altar
windows.description: One active altar: Arclight/Emberlight retain 85% damage; all other weapons retain 75%, rounded per hitsplat. This is an alternative state of the same boss, not another 450 HP. Activation timing, adds and incoming attacks are not simulated.

windows.label: 2 active altars
windows.description: Two active altars: Arclight/Emberlight retain 70% damage; other weapons retain 50%. Each hitsplat and bolt proc rounds separately. Shares Skotizo's comparison HP; random altar timing and incoming attacks remain outside this model.

windows.label: 3 active altars
windows.description: Three active altars: Arclight/Emberlight retain 55% damage; other weapons retain 25%. Separate hits are reduced before summing. This is a fixed outgoing comparison, with no altar or incoming sequence assumed.

windows.label: 4 active altars
windows.description: Four active altars: Arclight/Emberlight still retain 40% damage; other supported weapons deal zero direct damage, including ruby/diamond procs. Do not borrow this exception for other Demonbane weapons. Running, altar activation, adds and incoming damage are excluded.

windows.label: Active altar
windows.description: One active 100-HP altar. Arclight and Emberlight defeat it in one attack regardless of accuracy; Silverlight, Darklight, Demonbane spells and the scorching bow do not inherit that finisher. Other supported weapons use its recorded defences. Altar counts/respawns, running and full-fight timing are not assumed.

windows.label: Flowers cleared
windows.description: Farming Guild Hespori while all four flowers are cleared: ordinary outgoing damage and the recorded 100% fire weakness. Flowers open on waking and around two-thirds/one-third HP. These thresholds, movement, poison, entangle and incoming attacks are not timed; this is not a full-kill budget.

windows.label: Flowers alive
windows.description: Farming Guild Hespori while any flower remains alive: direct weapon/spell damage, including bolt procs, is zero. Clear the flowers before attacking the body. Recoil, Retribution, burn, roots, poison, incoming attacks and transition timing are not simulated.

windows.label: Flowers · one-hit targets
windows.description: Farming Guild flowers die in one attack from any supported weapon, regardless of accuracy or ordinary max hit. Four flowers open in each of three waves: this separate budget counts 12 attack cooldowns. Travel, projectile flight, body/flower transitions and incoming attacks are excluded. The quest flower is a different NPC and does not inherit this guarantee.
A Night at the Theatre flowers do not always die in one hit. Their attack-specific damage rules need independent verification; the Farming Guild guarantee is not reused here.

windows.label: Serpentine · neutralised
windows.description: First 275 HP after the correct chemical vent has neutralised the Hydra. Before neutralisation, choose the separate protected comparison. Vent timing, wrong-vent attack boosts, poison, protection rotations and incoming damage are not simulated.

windows.label: Electric · neutralised
windows.description: Second 275-HP stage after the correct chemical. Starts at 825 HP; ruby damage uses this stage's HP. Lightning, vent timing, protection rotations and incoming damage remain unverified.

windows.label: Fire · neutralised
windows.description: Third 275-HP stage after the correct chemical. Starts at 550 HP; ruby damage falls with current HP. Fire walls, tracking fire, vent timing and incoming damage are not simulated.

windows.label: Final phase
windows.description: Final 275 HP, with ordinary outgoing damage and no chemical shield. Alternating incoming attacks, poison/fire, movement, transition overshoot and full-fight timing remain unverified.

windows.label: Before chemical
windows.description: Before the correct chemical vent: each outgoing hitsplat, including ruby/diamond procs, is reduced to one quarter and rounded down. This is a comparison state, not an additional HP stage. Vent delay and incoming damage are not simulated.

windows.label: Before chemical
windows.description: Electric form before neutralisation: outgoing hits are quartered per hitsplat after bolt effects. Shares the second stage's HP workload; wrong-vent damage boosts, lightning and incoming attacks are unverified.

windows.label: Before chemical
windows.description: Fire form before neutralisation: outgoing hits are quartered per hitsplat after bolt effects. Shares the third stage's HP workload; vent timing, fire attacks, protection rotations and incoming damage are unverified.

Unshielded ranged-form outgoing attacks use its recorded defences, spectral attribute and air weakness. Selected unshielded forms share a 723-HP comparison allocation; no fixed rotation is assumed. Form thresholds, the four-damaging-hit requirement, spikes, teleports, healing and incoming attacks are not simulated. The prayer shield remains unsupported.

Unshielded melee-form outgoing attacks use its recorded defences and air weakness. Selected unshielded forms share the same 723-HP comparison pool. Resistance comes from recorded defences, not an extra damage divisor. Freezes, step-back timing, form thresholds, the four-hit requirement, prayer shield and incoming damage remain unverified.

Vulnerable final stand after the prayer shield is removed, starting at an explicit 127-HP comparison allocation. Shield timing/overshoot, spike growth, healing and incoming damage are excluded. The shielded NPC remains blocked.

Normal post-quest Vardorvis. Defence falls linearly from 215 to 145 and Strength rises from 270 to 360 as HP falls from 700 to zero; interpolation floors after the complete fraction. Current HP is applied before assumed stat reductions. The finite-HP attack budget recomputes the complete outgoing distribution at every HP. Axes, head, entangle, lifesteal, movement and incoming attacks are excluded; quest/awakened variants remain blocked.

windows.label: Awake
windows.description: Normal post-quest awake combat only, with 70% Demonbane effectiveness: a 70% weapon bonus becomes 49%. Preparation/poison, gaze, gas, enrage timing and incoming attacks are not simulated. Quest and awakened variants remain unsupported.

windows.label: Exposed vents
windows.description: Four 50-HP respiratory systems while the Sire is stunned. Accurate ordinary hits have a 50%-of-max minimum; supported Demonbane attacks kill on a successful hit, without guaranteeing accuracy. Only ranged, magic and polearms can reach. Active-tentacle protection, the stun timer, regeneration and travel are excluded.

Vulnerable phase-2 outgoing attacks, using 425→210 HP for comparison; prior stun/transition damage is not assumed. Transition damage reduction, forced teleport, fumes, spawns, movement and incoming attacks remain unverified.
Stationary vulnerable phase-3 outgoing window, allocated 210→140 HP. Walking-transition reduction, phase overshoot/reset, fumes, spawns and incoming damage are excluded.
Vulnerable final outgoing attacks after avoiding the explosion, allocated the final 140 HP. Explosion timing, reset/healing safeguards, spawns, movement, fumes and incoming damage are not simulated.

windows.label: Serpentine
windows.description: Reviewed outgoing window: hits above 50 reroll uniformly into 45–50, including ruby/diamond bolts. Ordinary melee cannot reach Zulrah. Forms share one 500-HP comparison workload with equal allocations, not an observed rotation. Movement, rotations, venom, snakelings and incoming damage are unverified.

windows.label: Magma
windows.description: Reviewed outgoing hit cap and reach rules. This form shares the 500-HP comparison workload with the other selected forms; equal allocations are a gear-comparison assumption. Rotation timing, incoming attacks and full-fight supplies remain unverified.

windows.label: Tanzanite
windows.description: Reviewed outgoing hit cap and reach rules, with this form's recorded defences. Shares one 500-HP comparison workload across forms. Incoming attacks, rotation timing, venom and snakelings are not simulated.

windows.label: Emerged
windows.description: Emerged boss only: melee cannot reach; positive ranged hits are divided by seven with a minimum of one. Misses remain zero. Awakening, tentacles, incoming attacks, healing and trip supplies are not simulated; whirlpools remain unsupported.

windows.label: Emerged
windows.description: Emerged cave kraken: positive ranged hits are divided by seven with a minimum of one; misses remain zero. Boss melee immunity is not borrowed by this smaller NPC. Awakening and incoming damage are not simulated; whirlpools remain unsupported.

windows.label: Outgoing attacks
windows.description: Magic and eligible stab weapons deal full damage; other supported attacks are halved per rolled hit. Diamond effects precede this reduction; ruby procs retain full damage and use current HP. Defence drains are explicit assumptions. Dark core, incoming damage, healing and full encounter timing are not simulated.

Ordinary outgoing attacks use Supreme's recorded defences. Other styles are resistant, not declared immune. Selected incoming ranged attacks are available separately; overlapping aggro, Spinolyps, respawns and poison are not simulated.

Ordinary outgoing attacks use Prime's recorded defences. No invented combat-triangle immunity. Selected incoming magic attacks are available separately; aggro overlap, Spinolyps and respawns remain unverified.

Ordinary outgoing attacks use Rex's recorded defences and elemental weakness. No invented combat-triangle immunity. Selected incoming slash attacks are available separately; safespots, aggro, Spinolyps and respawns remain unverified.

windows.label: Crawling
windows.description: First form: the overhead symbols indicate increased recorded defences, not complete style immunity. Normal outgoing attacks and supported Keris effects are enabled. Selected incoming stab, guaranteed-accuracy ranged and magic attacks are available separately. Attack mixtures, workers, prayer drain and movement are not modelled.

windows.label: Airborne
windows.description: Second form: melee remains possible against the higher recorded melee defences. Overhead symbols do not make her immune. Normal outgoing attacks, supported Keris effects and separate basic incoming scenarios are enabled; attack mixtures, workers and full encounter timing remain unverified.

Ordinary outgoing attacks with flying-target reach rules: normal melee is blocked; polearms and salamanders require independently supported weapon rules. Bodyguards, knockback, movement, incoming attacks and chinchompa multi-target damage are not simulated.

Vulnerable Dawn only, with flying-target reach rules and recorded defences. Her separate vulnerable phases, sphere healing, lightning and incoming attacks are not timed. This is an outgoing comparison, not a full kill workload.

windows.label: Vulnerable first form
windows.description: Vulnerable first form only: Dusk is immune to ranged and magic; recorded -1 flat armour applies to accurate melee hits. His two forms share one comparison HP pool with equal allocations, not verified phase thresholds. Invulnerability, movement, lightning and incoming damage are not simulated.

windows.label: Vulnerable second form
windows.description: Vulnerable final form only: ranged and magic remain immune. Uses the final form's recorded stats; shares Dusk's comparison HP pool. Phase thresholds, flame-prison healing, movement and incoming damage remain unverified.

windows.label: Final shadow flare
windows.description: One 71-HP normal final-phase shadow flare. Magic guarantees maximum damage with the reviewed Demonbane/Mark rules. This comparison does not predict flare spawns, regeneration, movement, glyph timing or healing Yama.

windows.label: Obelisk
windows.description: Solo, path-zero outgoing obelisk attacks at raid levels 0–150. Energy troughs, charged shots, movement, special attacks and incoming damage are outside this attack window.

windows.label: P2 shield
windows.description: Only attack with the style not currently protected. Melee is always protected. Accuracy is guaranteed; accuracy roll determines the 15–40% to 35–60% damage band. This is one shield exposure, not all of P2; shield regeneration, prayer rotations, obelisk specials and core timing are excluded.

windows.label: P2 shield
windows.description: Only attack with the style not currently protected; melee remains protected. Guaranteed accuracy with the P2 accuracy-based damage band. This is one shield exposure; rotations, regeneration, specials and core timing are excluded.

windows.label: Core
windows.description: Ordinary melee attacks guarantee their maximum hit on the exposed core. Core HP uses the solo 1%-per-10-invocations scaling before rounding. The exposure limit, five-times transfer to the Warden, number of downs and special attacks are not a whole-P2 simulation.

windows.label: Core
windows.description: Guaranteed maximum ordinary melee hits during a core exposure, with the core-specific solo HP scaling. Exposure limits, damage transfer, number of downs and special attacks remain outside this comparison.

windows.label: P3
windows.description: Vulnerable P3 outgoing attacks at the recorded 150 base Defence. Ground slams, skull damage, phantoms, enrage healing/reset and invocation-specific timing are excluded. Invulnerable variants remain blocked.

windows.label: P3
windows.description: Vulnerable P3 outgoing attacks at the recorded 150 base Defence. Ground slams, skull damage, phantoms, enrage healing/reset and invocation-specific timing are excluded. Invulnerable variants remain blocked.

windows.label: Acid attack window
windows.description: Outgoing attacks while successfully moving during acid: halve each final damage outcome, rounded down, including bolt effects. Freeze/spawn immunity, lost ticks, pool healing, specials and player survival are excluded. This is an optional attack-window comparison, not a full special-cycle kill time.

Conservative normal-fight state: magic defence is +60 when Yama's target uses Magic; slash defence is +80. This state represents approximately two-thirds of the boss's 2,500 HP. Glyphs, movement, flares, transitions and incoming damage are not simulated.
windows.label: Phases 1–2

windows.description: Explicit duo/off-tank state: magic defence is -30 only while Yama's current target is not using Magic. Do not use it for a solo mage. Same boss HP allocation as the conservative P1–2 window; choose one P1–2 state.
windows.label: Off-tank

windows.description: Normal final phase: increased defence bonuses, +81 magic defence and seven-tick auto-attacks. Represents approximately one-third of 2,500 boss HP. Special attacks, perfect-dodge speed-ups, flare healing and prayer piercing are not simulated.
windows.label: Final phase

windows.description: Judge of Yama guarantees maximum hits with alternating Magic and melee. Magic attacks first; reactive prayers then require the other style. Use the paired cycle estimate for both intermissions rather than treating one style as an entire kill.
windows.label: Judge

windows.description: Judge Magic attacks: guaranteed maximum hit while its reactive prayers allow Magic. The normal fight has two 400-HP intermissions, each starting with Magic then alternating melee. The paired attack-cycle estimate combines both complete gear sets; travel, dodge delay and environmental damage are excluded.
windows.label: Judge · Magic

windows.description: Judge melee attacks: guaranteed maximum hit while its reactive prayers allow melee. Alternate after a Magic hit. The paired attack-cycle estimate combines both complete sets across two 400-HP intermissions; movement and environmental damage are excluded.
windows.label: Judge · Melee

windows.description: Contract modifiers, inverted prayer scaling and altered phase thresholds are not modelled. Do not use the normal-fight damage model.
windows.label: Contract

windows.description: One pair of full-health Void Flares (140 HP each) is a declared gear-comparison probe, not a prediction of how many pairs spawn. Magic guarantees a maximum hit; demonbane vulnerability is 200%. Regeneration, projectile travel, flare healing and movement are excluded. Standard ranged max-hit behaviour is not enabled until its weapon effects are supported.
windows.label: Void flares

windows.description: A full-health normal Void Flare has 140 base HP and 200% demonbane vulnerability. Magic guarantees its maximum hit. Regeneration, the explosion and healing Yama are excluded; contracts and ranged weapon effects are not borrowed from this window.
windows.label: Void Flare
